products.description:
Retire an app the right way — and prove it's actually gone

Every org is good at deploying apps and bad at retiring them. The vendor went end-of-life, a security finding landed on a product nobody owns, two teams bought the same tool, or you're paying maintenance on 400 licenses that 26 people use. Nobody removes it, because removal feels risky and nobody owns the decision. Then someone finally tries — and either destroys user data they should have kept, or cancels the license while the software is still 60% installed. This solution turns “delete the app and hope” into a governed retirement campaign on your Intune-managed Windows fleet.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the full retirement discipline as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by five ready-to-run PowerShell scripts.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every group, assignment, and object you touch is named (e.g. APPRET-LGT – LegacyTrack Client – Uninstall – Wave 0 Pilot) and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; comparable consulting runs well into the thousands per day. Buy once, reuse the playbook for every app you retire.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates and a hard data-preservation checkpoint before the irreversible step.

The truth about how Intune actually removes software

This is the mechanic most retirements get wrong. The guide is blunt about it: the Uninstall assignment intent runs the app's stored uninstall command on the device — Required beats Uninstall, so an old install assignment silently blocks removal; deleting the app object uninstalls nothing (it just blinds you); and completion is bounded by how often devices check in. You'll never again wonder why “I assigned Uninstall and nothing happened.”

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the retirement pipeline, the five triggers (EOL/EOS, security, redundancy, low utilisation, license cost), how the Uninstall intent and supersedence behave, and honest limitations (irreversibility, check-in bound).
  • Requirements Guide — roles, Graph read scopes, a working uninstall command, a reliable detection rule, real usage evidence, a named owner/approver, the data-handling determination, and wave groups — each with how to verify.
  • Implementation Guide — the 15-step campaign: decision record, discovery, impact analysis, comms + grace period, wave groups, the data checkpoint, point the Uninstall intent (or use supersedence for a migration), validate, expand wave by wave, reclaim licenses, handle stragglers, clean up every artefact (groups, scripts, WDAC/App Control rules, Conditional Access references, SCCM remnants), produce the evidence pack, and monitor.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — install-base discovery, dependency/supersedence impact analyzer, retirement-wave reporter (status/planning/straggler classification), leftover-artefact finder, and decommission evidence export. Read-only by default; every script accepts -Environment USGov/USGovDoD for GCC High & DoD.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides — seven pass/fail gates (from data preservation to proof-of-closure) plus campaign-level troubleshooting (nothing removed, partial fleet, reappearance, reporting gaps).

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each retirement feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next app and the next project.

The bottom line

Every retired application is decided, communicated, data-protected, staged, cleaned up, license-reclaimed, and proven gone with an audit-ready evidence pack — a repeatable method and scripts your team keeps and reuses.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Complete Solution Package (ZIP) containing:
    • Implementation Guide (PDF & Word) — the complete, click-by-click solution: overview, requirements, the 15-step retirement campaign, testing & validation gates, campaign-level troubleshooting, and best practices.
    • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (all read-only by default; no script performs a deletion — removal is done deliberately in the portal):
      • APPRET-Discovery.ps1 — install base + assignments/intents + dependency/supersedence + per-device install list
      • APPRET-ImpactAnalyzer.ps1 — what breaks if you remove it: dependents, supersedence chains, assign groups, shared detection scripts
      • APPRET-WaveReporter.ps1 — wave status (the gate check), wave planning, and straggler classification
      • APPRET-ArtifactFinder.ps1 — leftover artefacts: app object, groups (SAFE vs SHARED), CA references, enterprise app, remediation scripts
      • APPRET-EvidenceExport.ps1 — compile the decommission evidence pack (final status, residuals, remaining artefacts)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
